note: Set A and Set B contain the same six claims with identical values, conditions, and supporting quotes; the only difference is that A includes the symbol Θpitch in two attribute names while B omits it. Both correctly capture the 4° maximum positive blade pitch at low wind speeds, the design point (TSR 9.0, Θpitch 0°), the optimum (TSR 8.5, Θpitch −1.0°), and the ~90 m force peak location. Neither set misreads or invents anything, so they are effectively equivalent.
remarks: Both sets omit the fact that the sharp linear drop over the outboard 5% of the blade is caused by the Prandtl tip loss model, and the Region 3 rated-torque saturation / pitch-to-feather behavior; since both sets are complete samples of 6 claims, these omissions affect both equally. The 'maximum CP' condition on the optimal TSR/pitch pair is a reasonable reading of 'the optimal' referenced to the CP and CT curves.
